summary: Iteration-2 testing: 43/43 backend pytest tests passed (30 regression + 13 new). New coverage: payments mock config, mock checkout -> confirmed booking with amount_paid, /payments/verify/{ref} mock success, owner Ghana-Card verification E2E (register unverified -> 403 on create_turf -> submit multipart (card + selfie PNG) -> pending -> admin lists -> admin GET /files/{path} with ?auth=token returns image, without token 401 -> admin approve -> owner can POST /owner/turfs 200), cron reminders (401 without secret, 200 {status:ok,reminders_sent:N} with Bearer gt_cron_...). Frontend Playwright: Home List/Map toggle works, Leaflet map (data-testid turf-map) shows markers across Accra; owner portal /owner/login lands owner@goturf.gh on /owner; admin portal /admin/login lands kpomsgh@gmail.com on /admin; Verifications admin tab renders submission cards with Ghana Card number + CARD/SELFIE preview panels; non-admin customer rejected at /admin/login (stays on page, not routed to /admin); customer login at /auth lands on /my-bookings. Regression test file updated to pass contact param to /cancel and /reschedule-request (which now correctly require ownership via authorize_booking - the security concern flagged in iteration_1 has been fixed).

minor.issue: Still using deprecated FastAPI on_event; migrate to lifespan handlers (same as prev iteration).
approve is a query-string bool (?approve=true) rather than JSON body - consistent with other admin mutators but still unusual.

Owner path check uses substring match on `/verifications/{id}/` inside the given path; works but is fragile — a crafted path like foo/verifications/{other}/bar/verifications/{self}/x would pass. Low risk since storage keys are server-generated.
Token passed via ?auth= query param gets logged in request/access logs (vs headers). Acceptable for internal links from React, but consider using short-lived signed URLs long term.
File is now 1386 lines (up from 1057); well past the 700-line threshold. Split into routes/auth/payments/verification/admin modules.

issues: CARD/SELFIE preview panels render as empty boxes when the uploaded image is tiny (test uploads were 1x1 PNGs). With real uploads they should render; consider adding an onError placeholder + visible border/background so an unloadable image is obvious to admins.

action_items: Modularize server.py (1386 LOC) into submodules — critical for maintainability.
Add onError placeholder on admin verification image previews.
Consider signed URLs instead of ?auth=token query param for /files/{path}.
critical_code_review_comments: serve_file ownership check uses substring match on the storage path; prefer validating path starts with f"{APP_NAME}/verifications/{user_id}/" exactly.
verification_decision uses a trailing-expression short-circuit (`await send_email(...) if v.get('owner_email') else None`) — works but is harder to read; use a conditional block.

Cron endpoint comment says 'enqueue/background the actual work' but the handler still awaits send_sms + send_email inline per booking in the request path. For >~50 due reminders this could time out; move to a background task.

confirm_booking is idempotent on status=='confirmed' but doesn't guard against concurrent calls (two Paystack verify + webhook arriving together). Consider findOneAndUpdate with status filter for atomicity.

init_storage() is called synchronously in startup; failure is only logged — subsequent put_object/get_object calls will raise 500. Acceptable given the live Emergent object storage, but surface a readiness flag.
No input validation on ghana_card_number format (should match GHA-XXXXXXXXX-X).
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (updated cancel + reschedule tests to pass contact= param now that endpoints require authorization)

success_rate.frontend: 100% of flows attempted (map toggle, owner portal, admin portal + verifications tab, non-admin reject, customer /auth)

test_credentials: Loaded from /app/memory/test_credentials.md; all three roles + cron secret verified end-to-end.
seed_data_creation: Each test run creates 1 unverified owner (test_owner_{hex}@goturf.gh), submits verification with 1x1 PNG files to object storage, admin approves it, and owner creates 1 TEST turf. Residual data accumulates (4 approved TEST_Owner cards visible in admin Verifications UI) — consider periodic cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend has two test files now: backend_test.py (regression, 30 tests) and test_iteration2.py (new features, 13 tests). The /cancel and /reschedule-request endpoints now REQUIRE authorize_booking — pass ?contact={email_or_phone} query param when not authenticated, else 403. Payments live in MOCK mode (PAYSTACK_SECRET empty); POST /bookings/{id}/checkout returns {mode:'mock'} and directly confirms the booking (bypasses /pay). SMS is MOCKED (logs only). Owner verification is enforced on POST /owner/turfs (not PUT). File auth accepts either Authorization header OR ?auth=token query param. Each test_iteration2 run adds residual owners + verifications in Mongo — fine for now, but if seed data starts conflicting consider cleaning db.users where email LIKE 'test_owner_%'.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs encountered. The two initial regression failures were test-file issues (missing contact= param); iteration-2 correctly tightened auth on cancel/reschedule per the security concern flagged in iteration_1.
security_notes: Previously-flagged auth gap on /cancel and /reschedule-request is FIXED via new authorize_booking() helper (requires owning user, admin, or matching customer contact).
